items.title: FFmpeg before 9.1 Out-of-Bounds Read via XWD Encoder Scanline Padding
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in xwd encode frame() in libavcodec/xwdenc.c that copies each RGB24 or BGR24 row using the padded XWD scanline size instead of the pixel row size. Attackers who control the width of video encoded to XWD by an application that supplies tightly packed frames can make the encoder read past the frame buffer, crashing the application or leaking heap contents…

items.title: FFmpeg before 9.1 Out-of-Bounds Read via PCX Encoder Odd-Width Rows
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in pcx encode frame() in libavcodec/pcxenc.c that rounds each row up to an even number of bytes and run-length encodes that many bytes from the input frame. Attackers who control the width of images encoded to PCX by an application that supplies tightly packed frames can make the encoder read past the end of the frame buffer, crashing the application or…

items.title: FFmpeg before 9.1 NULL Pointer Dereference via XSUB Encoder Empty Subtitles
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in xsub encode() in libavcodec/xsubenc.c that only warns when a subtitle has no rectangles and then dereferences rects 0 . Attackers can supply crafted PGS or DVB subtitles that decode to empty subtitle events, crashing applications that pass decoded subtitles directly to the XSUB encoder.

Attackers can supply crafted video in which some frames lack Dolby Vision metadata to an SVT-AV1 encode with Dolby Vision RPU coding enabled, leaking each rejected frame's buffers or aborting in av frame move ref() in builds…

items.title: FFmpeg 3.0 before 8.1.3 Heap Buffer Overflow via boxblur Filter
items.summary: FFmpeg 3.0 before 8.1.3 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in libavfilter/vf boxblur.c because query formats() accepts pixel formats deeper than 16 bits while the blur temporary buffers hold only 2 bytes per pixel. Attackers can supply crafted 32-bit float media, such as PFM or OpenEXR images, that when processed by the boxblur filter overflow the temporary buffers, crashing applications or possibly…

items.title: FFmpeg 5.0 before 8.1.3 NULL Pointer Dereference via IMF Virtual Track Without Resources
items.summary: FFmpeg 5.0 before 8.1.3 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in the IMF demuxer in libavformat/imfdec.c because open virtual track() accepts a virtual track with no resources. Attackers can supply a crafted IMF Composition Playlist whose virtual track lists no resources, causing set context streams from tracks() to dereference a NULL resource array and crash the process.

items.title: FFmpeg 5.0 before 8.1.3 NULL Pointer Dereference via IMF Asset Map Missing Path
items.summary: FFmpeg 5.0 before 8.1.3 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in parse imf asset map from xml dom() in libavformat/imfdec.c that does not check for a missing or empty Path element in an asset map Chunk. Attackers can supply a crafted IMF ASSETMAP.xml whose Chunk lacks a Path, passing a NULL URI to the path handling functions and crashing the process.

items.title: Integer Overflow in GNU m4
items.summary: GNU m4 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in reload frozen state() in src/freeze.c. When processing a malicious frozen-state file via the -R option, an attacker can trigger an oversized allocation request that crashes the program, causing denial of service. This issue was fixed in commit 69aef802fb25ab600d37210f44e5128633cbc432.
